name: Trusted Gmail
shortDescription: Securely accesses Gmail through AWS Nitro enclaves, enabling email search, retrieval, and sending while protecting sensitive credentials

rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Gmail MCP server running inside a secure AWS Nitro enclave, providing email functionality through a remote interface. Originally forked from Claude Post, this implementation uses FastAPI and Server-Sent Events (SSE) transport to enable AI assistants to search, read, and send emails securely. The server authenticates with Gmail using app-specific passwords and includes tools for searching emails by date and keyword, retrieving email content, counting daily emails, and sending messages. The AWS Nitro enclave provides hardware-based attestation to verify code integrity, ensuring sensitive email credentials remain protected within the trusted execution environment.
